nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A narrow gap between the cars. Once you’re past them the way is there; you just couldn’t see it from the other end.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: White court lines carry on past the fence. You don’t see there’s another school gate until you’re up to it.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Through the alley gate you can see a court marked with white lines.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: No school name on this side. Try the handle.
